'''Guter Wade system''', or '''Rattatak system''', was the home [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], located in the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
